power.origins_classes_iss.archmagus_armo: Archmagus bẹrẹ pẹlu eto kikun ti Armor Magician Magician
power.origins_classes_iss.archmagus_heal: O ni 2 kere si awọn ọkan ti ilera ju deede.
power.origins_classes_iss.archmagus_powe: O ni 25% ti o tobi Sipeli Agbara.
power.origins_classes_iss.archmagus_weak: Awọn adehun 75% dinku ibajẹ pẹlu awọn ikọlu melee.
power.origins_classes_iss.bard_hide_from: Lakoko ti o ti yọkuro, o le farapamọ lati awọn egungun ti ko tii rii ọ sibẹsibẹ.
power.origins_classes_iss.bard_inspirati: Nigbati o ba mu iwo ewurẹ kan, gbogbo awọn oṣere ti o wa nitosi ati awọn wolves gba Strenth I fun iṣẹju marun
power.origins_classes_iss.bard_melodic_p: Bards ni 20% diẹ sii Melody Spell Power. (Nilo Tunes n Tomes)
power.origins_classes_iss.bard_rattle_bo: Chase kuro spiders ati silverfish nigba ti o dani egungun.
power.origins_classes_iss.bard_tires_eas: Ijakadi ti ara gba owo rẹ.
power.origins_classes_iss.mystic_holy_sp: Mystics ni 20% ti o tobi Mimọ lọkọọkan Power.
power.origins_classes_iss.mystic_illager: Mystics gba 25% ti o tobi bibajẹ lati Illagers.
power.origins_classes_iss.mystic_resista: Awọn abule ti o ṣowo pẹlu jèrè Resistance IV patapata.
power.origins_classes_iss.mystic_scroll_: Gba iṣẹju 1 ti Igbega Ilera lẹhin lilo yi lọ.
power.origins_classes_iss.mystic_turn_un: Nigbati o ba ni ipese pẹlu Star Nether, gbogbo awọn undead bẹru rẹ.
power.origins_classes_iss.shadowcaster_d: Shadowcasters simẹnti ìráníyè 10% dara ninu awọn dudu.
O ni 5% kere si lọkọọkan agbara nigba ọjọ.
O jèrè Iran Night ni okunkun.
power.origins_classes_iss.shadowcaster_e: O ni 20% Ender Spell Power to dara julọ
power.origins_classes_iss.sorcerer_fire_: O ni 10% ti o dara ju Ina lọkọọkan Power.
power.origins_classes_iss.sorcerer_healt: O ni ọkan ti o dinku ti ilera ju deede.
power.origins_classes_iss.sorcerer_ice_p: O ni 10% to dara ju Ice Spell Power.
power.origins_classes_iss.sorcerer_oaksk: Gba Oakskin nigbati o wa labẹ ilera idaji.
power.origins_classes_iss.sorcerer_spell: Awọn oṣó ni aye 25% ti nini ailera nigbati ikọlu melee.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_eldrit: O ni 20% tobi Eldritch Spell Power.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_golden: O gbọdọ jẹ Apple Golden kan lojoojumọ bi irubọ si Patron rẹ tabi jiya ailera.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_magic_: O le sọ Missile Magic ni alẹ nipa ti ara.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_penalt: Ti o ko ba ti rubọ si olutọju rẹ, jèrè Slowness II ati ailera II.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_retrib: Ohunkankan ti o ba ọ jẹ jere awọn aaya 30 ti ailera.
power.origins_classes_iss.warlock_starte: Warlocks bẹrẹ pẹlu a Golden Apple.
power.origins_classes_iss.warmage_cooldo: O ni Idinku Itutu agbaiye ti o tobi ju 10%.
power.origins_classes_iss.warmage_scroll: Gba ọgbọn-aaya 30 ti Gbigba agbara lẹhin lilo yi lọ.
power.origins_classes_iss.warmage_spell_: Gba + 10% Sipeli Agbara nigbati o wa labẹ ilera idaji.
O ni 10% kere si lọkọọkan resistance nigbati lori idaji ilera.
power.origins_classes_iss.wizard_essence: O le ṣe ipilẹ arcane lati Lapis Lazuli mẹrin.
power.origins_classes_iss.wizard_ink_rec: O le ṣe inki ti o wọpọ ti ara rẹ lati Arcane Essence, apo inki ati igo gilasi kan.
power.origins_classes_iss.wizard_spellbo: Ti o bẹrẹ pẹlu kan spellbook ati Firecracker lọkọọkan.
